summary: Good Boys' FlatOut-inspired demolition racing game, built around destructive racing, derby events, stunt challenges, escape modes, and split-screen/Remote Play support.

entries.title: Trail Out

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Trail Out released for Windows, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and iOS. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for its destructible FlatOut-inspired racing, derby, stunt, and escape modes.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use PS4/Xbox One/Switch as console alternatives and iOS only for mobile access.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition.
